prompt.role: Act as an expert Android app developer (Kotlin/Jetpack Compose) and an elite UX/UI designer specializing in emotional and sensory design.

project_overview.concept: A daily photo journaling app designed to capture memories with the softness of cotton/cotton candy ("Som"). It encourages users to record their day with a photo and a short text, wrapping their memories in a deeply emotional and calming digital environment.

color_palette.primary_theme: Winter East Sea Magic Hour: A soft, vertical gradient blending pastel sky blue at the top and delicate pastel pink at the bottom.

design_system.animations: All interactions must feature soft easing, bouncy transitions, and fluid micro-animations to create a gentle, responsive feel.
design_system.assets: The UI must support and gracefully render high-resolution photo assets.

core_features.feature: A visually stunning home screen featuring a custom aesthetic heatmap (similar to contribution graphs) seamlessly integrated into the design. It tracks daily photo logs, gently nudging and encouraging the user to maintain their daily streak.
Allows users to record their day with a high-quality photo and a short text entry.

feature.name: Dynamic Input Modes
feature.mode: A clean, blank canvas for open-ended journaling.
A "Select Today's Question" feature. When tapped, a beautifully animated, Glassmorphic input form drops down or expands, providing a thoughtful prompt to inspire the user's daily record.

core_features.feature: Include a Settings UI, Profile, and Gallery views, all strictly adhering to the established emotional design language.

technical_requirements.ui_framework: Jetpack Compose (Required for optimal implementation of Glassmorphism, Neumorphism, and complex animations)

prompt.task: 1. Define the UX/UI layout architecture for the Main Heatmap Screen and the Journaling Screen. 2. Provide the Kotlin/Jetpack Compose code to generate the "Winter East Sea Magic Hour" gradient background. 3. Write the Jetpack Compose code for the main UI, including the Neumorphic cards, the Glassmorphic input form for "Today's Question", and the custom Heatmap UI. 4. Implement the smooth animation logic for switching between "Freeform" and "Guided" input modes.
